description: This file defines an interface 'Credentials' used for handling various credential types in a connectivty module. It includes methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, registration of credential subclasses, and visitor pattern support. The code is part of the Eclipse Ditto project, specifically within the connectivity model.

classes.name: Credentials
classes.description: An interface representing connection credentials, supporting extensible credential types, JSON serialization/deserialization, and visitor pattern.

classes.name: Credentials.JsonFields
classes.description: A nested abstract class containing common JSON field definitions and deserializer registration map for credential subclasses.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform operations based on the specific credential subclass.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the credential object to its JSON representation.

methods.name: registerDeserializer
methods.description: Registers a deserializer function for a specific credential subtype, identified by a type string.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a credential instance from its JSON representation by looking up the appropriate deserializer.
